risks.title: Controller compromise or irreversible rotation error
risks.description: A controller can replace both controller and authorizer. The one-step rotation has no on-chain acceptance handshake, so compromise or an incorrect destination can transfer control or make recovery impossible.
deploymentRequirements: Use a reviewed multisignature or policy contract for valuable Spaces.
Simulate and independently verify both replacement addresses before rotation.
Document an operational recovery and key-compromise procedure.
risks.reviewTrigger: Controller model, rotation flow, or recovery policy changes

risks.title: Compromised or overly permissive transition authorizer
risks.description: The Registry proves authorization and ordering, not that an authorized memory transition is true or desirable. A compromised authorizer can append valid-looking state.
deploymentRequirements: Separate controller and authorizer duties.
Use threshold, rate-limited, or session-scoped policy for valuable Spaces.
Monitor TransitionCommitted events and define incident response.

risks.title: EIP-7702 fallback preserves the underlying ECDSA authorization path
risks.description: ERC-8350 requires trying ERC-1271 before canonical ECDSA. For a delegated EOA, a valid underlying-key signature is therefore accepted even when delegate code would reject the same action. Delegate policy is not exclusive.
existingControls: behavior is explicit in the ERC and reference implementation
deploymentRequirements: Do not use a delegated EOA when delegate-exclusive policy is a security requirement.
Use a contract-account authorizer address for multisignature or policy-only control.
Treat the delegated EOA key as fully privileged.
risks.reviewTrigger: ERC-8350 signature-validation rules or EIP-7702 semantics change

risks.title: Relayer censorship and delay
risks.description: A relayer cannot alter signed Delta fields but can withhold, reorder pending submissions, or delay inclusion.
deploymentRequirements: Maintain a direct-submission path or multiple relayers.
Alert on stalled outbox entries and sequence gaps.

risks.title: Metadata leakage and weak commitment secrets
risks.description: Timing, sequence, profile identifiers, and commitment equality are public. Low-entropy payloads remain dictionary-attackable when salts are weak or reused.
existingControls: raw payloads and locators are absent from core calldata
deploymentRequirements: Use fresh cryptographically random 32-byte salts for every commitment domain.
Encrypt sensitive witnesses before storage and rotate encryption nonces and keys.
Use opaque per-Space profile identifiers when kind privacy is required.
risks.reviewTrigger: Commitment profile or public event schema changes

risks.title: Witness and locator unavailability
risks.description: A valid on-chain commitment can become permanently unopenable if encrypted witnesses, salts, keys, or locators are lost. The contracts do not provide data availability.
existingControls: AuditGrant can bind an out-of-band disclosure set
deploymentRequirements: Use redundant encrypted storage and tested restoration procedures.
Define retention, key escrow, and availability service levels per profile.

risks.title: Fork replay before operational finality
risks.description: The EIP-712 domain binds chain ID and Registry address, but two branches of the same chain can temporarily share both values.
existingControls: chain ID and verifying-contract domain binding
deploymentRequirements: Apply an application-specific confirmation/finality policy.
Reconcile transition heads after a material chain reorganization.
risks.reviewTrigger: Target chain or finality assumptions change

risks.title: External smart-account validation defects or gas griefing
risks.description: Authorization depends on external ERC-1271 code. A wallet can be buggy, mutable, unexpectedly permissive, or consume enough gas to make operations unreliable.
deploymentRequirements: Use a reviewed wallet implementation and pin its upgrade authority.
Test valid, invalid, reverting, and malformed-return behavior before registration.
risks.reviewTrigger: Wallet implementation or upgrade authority changes

risks.title: Wrappers and proxies can change immutable reference semantics
risks.description: The reference Registry is non-upgradeable. A third-party proxy, wrapper, or modified deployment can introduce admin powers or behavior not covered by the review.
existingControls: verifying-contract address in the EIP-712 domain
deploymentRequirements: Publish and monitor deployed bytecode hashes.
Treat proxy or wrapper deployments as a new audit scope.
risks.reviewTrigger: Any bytecode, proxy, wrapper, or compiler-setting change

risks.title: Public extension metadata can disclose sensitive context
risks.description: Descriptor URIs, audit participants and ranges, acknowledgement timing, and deletion-attestation timing are public by construction.
existingControls: AuditGrant stores witness roots rather than witnesses
DeletionAttestation stores a commitment rather than evidence
deploymentRequirements: Never place secrets, salts, keys, private locators, or raw evidence in extension calldata.
Use the core without metadata extensions when relationship privacy is required.
risks.reviewTrigger: Extension event or calldata schema changes

risks.title: Attestations and audit acknowledgements are limited claims
risks.description: AuditGrant does not prove witness truth, auditor competence, or receipt. DeletionAttestation does not prove universal erasure and allows one immutable evidence commitment per transition.
deploymentRequirements: Present these records as scoped attestations, never as truth or universal deletion proofs.
Define off-chain auditor identity, evidence, and correction policy.
risks.reviewTrigger: Claim semantics or user-facing representations change

risks.title: Legacy Sepolia AuditGrant predates the cross-Space fix
risks.description: The 2026-07-26 test deployment does not bind grant IDs to their origin Space during revoke and acknowledge. A controller of another registered Space can revoke a grant, and an auditor can misattribute its acknowledgement event.
deploymentRequirements: Treat the legacy address as deprecated test evidence only.
Do not create or rely on grants at the legacy address.
Deploy the reviewed candidate to a new address only after G4 passes.
risks.reviewTrigger: New AuditGrant deployment or legacy-address documentation changes
